scope: Stored reference configuration and documented field meanings, not verified current government standards

App2Start.meaning: Legacy external application reference; basename only

BackgroundColor.meaning: Optional serialized colour value; not a quality score

LandCode.meaning: Legacy identifier; do not assume this is an ISO country code

RadioBtnlabel.meaning: Label for the special workflow action

RequiredDigitalFileSizeMax.meaning: Maximum digital JPEG size; exact byte conversion requires tracing

RequiredDigitalFileSizeMin.meaning: Minimum digital JPEG size; exact byte conversion requires tracing

RequiredDigitalHeight.meaning: Required digital export height; -1 means no explicit requirement

RequiredDigitalWidth.meaning: Required digital export width; -1 means no explicit requirement

URLforSpecs.meaning: Stored specification link; may be stale or refer to another country

bBlockBGtool.meaning: Disable background editing for this document

bDoAutoCrop.meaning: Run automatic crop for this document

bDoICAOcheck.meaning: Run automatic quality checking for this document

bForceCutmarks.meaning: Document requests cut marks on its print sheet

bGlassesForbidden.meaning: Document policy forbids glasses; independent of detecting glare

bUseFaceWidth.meaning: Enable width-based geometry; do not discard when height is also enabled

bUseISOtemplate.meaning: Use the country's named quality profile instead of the global selection

bUseZoomFactor.meaning: Use the legacy zoom-factor framing mode

iEyesHeight.meaning: Target eye-line position measured from the photo top

iEyesHeightMax.meaning: Maximum eye-line position from the photo top

iEyesHeightMin.meaning: Minimum eye-line position from the photo top

iFaceHeight.meaning: Target head/face height; landmark/crown definition needs engine tracing

iFreeFrameHeight.meaning: Free-frame parameter; physical interpretation not yet traced

iFreeFrameWidth.meaning: Free-frame parameter; physical interpretation not yet traced

iRadioButton2Use.meaning: Legacy special-mode button selection; enum mapping not established

iZoomFactor.meaning: Legacy zoom factor; not a universal physical measurement
